destination.name: Cairns
destination.tagline: The tropical gateway to the Great Barrier Reef, the Daintree and Kuranda
destination.description: Cairns is a city of about 150,000 on Trinity Bay in Far North Queensland, and its main industry is tourism. Reef trips, dive and snorkel tours, rafting and skydiving leave from here, and Kuranda and the Daintree Rainforest are day trips away. In town, a free lagoon pool and barbecues line the Esplanade, and the swimming beaches lie just north and south of the city.
whyVisit: Set out for the Great Barrier Reef
Cool off in the Esplanade Lagoon
Visit Kuranda and the Daintree rainforest

goodToKnow.title: Stinger season
goodToKnow.detail: From about October to May, swim only in net enclosures, such as Palm Cove, or the free Esplanade Lagoon.

goodToKnow.title: Wet season cyclones
goodToKnow.detail: Tropical cyclones can hit between December and March, damaging infrastructure and stopping public activities. Check forecasts before booking then.

goodToKnow.title: Peak season crowds
goodToKnow.detail: June to August is busiest, and the first two weeks of July (school holidays) are the peak.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: {months} is the dry season, with Jun–Aug the peak. Stinger season runs about Oct–May.
